parameters.question: Compare classification reports from a 1D CNN that sorts ECG signals into normal vs. arrhythmic (70/30 split, 50 epochs, batch 32). Per-class precision, recall, and F1 must match within +/-0.10. Row and column order may differ.

Compare CNN performance metrics for classifying ECG signals as normal or arrhythmic (1D CNN, 256 time points, 70/30 split, 50 epochs, batch size 32). Accuracy values must match within +/-0.10. Row and column order may differ.

Compare 2x2 confusion matrices (normal vs. arrhythmic) from a 1D CNN ECG classifier trained on a random 70/30 split for 50 epochs. Convert each cell count to a proportion of total test samples; each proportion must be within +/-0.10 of the reference proportion. Class label naming (e.g., 0/1 vs normal/arrhythmic) and row/column order may differ, so align cells by actual/predicted class semantics.
